description: Nature-Based Solutions for Coastal Highway Resilience: An Implementation Guide is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by publisher not stated on the toolkit page. Nature-based solutions can serve as a first line of defense and improve the resilience of coastal highways. FHWA developed Nature-Based Solutions for Coastal Highway Resilience: An Implementation Guide to help transportation professionals understand when, where, and which nature-based solutions may work for them. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
